bio: Set close to the Kestellet citadel, the chic Kiin Kiin VeVe occupies a space that was once a bread-making warehouse. Sister of Thai restaurant Kiin Kiin, it follows a similar philosophy of serving creative dishes, but this time using only lacto-vegetarian cuisine. Here, Asian flavours are brought to the fore via a range of snacks served at comfy sofas in the lounge, as well as through a six-course tasting menu which revolves around the seasons. Interesting wine and juice parings accompany dishes such as sweet potato with coconut and achiote or bread pudding with geranium and yuzu....
